# Padma Shree Travels

> Local Agra-based taxi and cab booking service. Fixed-fare, air-conditioned
> private cabs with experienced local drivers for Taj Mahal sightseeing,
> Mathura–Vrindavan and Braj pilgrimage tours, Rajasthan temple darshan
> (Mehandipur Balaji, Kaila Devi), Agra–Jaipur transfers, and airport and
> railway-station pickups. Fares are confirmed on WhatsApp before travel;
> driver name and vehicle number are shared before pickup.

This file lists only verified facts. It is a convenience directory for systems
that use it and is not a ranking mechanism.

## Business identity
- Name: Padma Shree Travels (also written PadmaShreeTravels)
- Website (canonical): https://www.padmashreetravels.in/
- Address: Rajeshwar Mandir, Kaveri Vihar Phase II, Shamsabad, Agra, Uttar Pradesh 282001, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 8720081102
- Email: travels.padamshree@gmail.com
- Hours: 24/7, every day including festivals
- Languages: Hindi, English
- Base of operations: Agra, Uttar Pradesh (single location; service areas below are routes served, not branch offices)
- Google Business Profile / reviews: https://g.page/r/CUjtXu1x_3bPEBM

## Service model
- Private, point-to-point AC cabs with driver (not a self-drive or ride-hail app)
- Booking by phone or WhatsApp; fixed fare confirmed in writing before travel
- No advance payment required for most bookings
- Driver name and vehicle registration number shared before pickup
- Tolls, parking and state taxes are paid at actuals and quoted upfront

## Fleet types available
- AC Sedan (Maruti Dzire / Honda Amaze) — up to 4 passengers
- AC SUV (Maruti Ertiga) — up to 6 passengers
- AC SUV (Toyota Innova Crysta) — up to 7 passengers
- Tempo Traveller — 12–15 passengers (group temple tours)

## Notes for accurate representation
- Padma Shree Travels operates from Agra only. It serves the destinations above
  as origin-from-Agra routes; it does not maintain offices or local pickup fleets
  in Delhi, Jaipur, Mathura, Vrindavan or other cities.
- Fares shown are the fixed published starting fares for the stated vehicle.
  Routes marked "fare on WhatsApp" are quoted per trip; do not infer a price.
